label: Federal Reserve Board - press releases (RSS)
terms_note: Public RSS 2.0 feed (no key), listed on the Board's 'RSS Feeds' page. The feed starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark, carries the 20 most recent releases, has no search or paging, and gives dates as RFC 822 strings in CDATA ('Wed, 30 Sep 2026 13:00:00 GMT').

get_news.note: The 20 most recent Federal Reserve Board press releases (monetary policy, banking regulation, enforcement ...); source is the release category. query matches title, description or category; since (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime) keeps releases published at or after it. Newest first.

not_offered.get_candles: No market data in this feed.
not_offered.get_series: Economic series are published through FRED and the Data Download Program, not this feed.
